releases.body:
- Fix rounded session durations carrying into the next minute: `1m60s` now
  displays as `2m00s`. Token, cost and timing accounting are unchanged.
- `/cpa-status` now shows the selected transport, compaction mode, fallback
  notes and pending settings. An OpenCode RPC outage is distinguished from
  failed CPA verification; a selected WebSocket transport is not a success claim.
- Manual tag publishing now verifies the exact public npm artifact and OIDC
  provenance, then creates a bilingual GitHub Release with tarball and checksum
  attachments. Retries continue only for identical artifacts; published versions,
  tags and conflicting assets are never overwritten.

- 修复耗时显示的分钟进位：`1m60s` 正确显示为 `2m00s`，不改变 token、费用或耗时记账。
- `/cpa-status` 补充选用的传输方式、压缩模式、回退说明及待生效设置，区分宿主 RPC 断连与 CPA 验证失败；选用 WebSocket 不代表请求已经成功。
- 手动 tag 发布会核验公开 npm 产物及 OIDC provenance，并生成双语 GitHub Release、包文件和校验和附件。同内容可安全重试，不覆盖已发布版本、正式 tag 或冲突附件。

**Verification remains bounded:** OpenCode `2.0.26` on Windows, packaged-plugin
mock checks and automated regressions; no additional real CPA or paid-model tests.
Existing native-compaction, physical-TUI and dependency-advisory limitations
still apply. See the linked verification and security notes.

测试仍限于 Windows / OpenCode `2.0.26` 的安装产物模拟验证与自动化回归，未新增真实 CPA 或收费模型测试；native 压缩、实际终端手动测试及依赖告警的既有边界保持不变。

releases.name: v0.1.0 — OpenCode v2 CPA provider
releases.body:
## English

First release of the CLIProxyAPI provider for OpenCode v2.

- Discover CPA models and use OpenCode's native HTTP/SSE or WebSocket connections, tool calls and conversation summaries.
- Set up a connection with a masked API-key prompt and save it in OpenCode's credential store.
- Toggle Fast mode, pause and resume requests, and view session duration, TPS, and token/cache usage.
- Install the server plugin and terminal interface together, without a source checkout.

### Install

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider@0.1.0
```

Then open OpenCode and run `/cpa-connect`. See the [README](https://github.com/Mistakey/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider/blob/v0.1.0/README.md) for configuration, commands and upgrades.

### Tested support

Tested with **OpenCode 2.0.26 on Windows**. [CI](https://github.com/Mistakey/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider/actions/runs/38350539294) passed typecheck, **281 tests** and **38 checks of the installed package**, using local mock services and test credentials.

Real CPA tests cover one model, `gpt-6.1-sol`. Native compaction has only been tested with a mock CPA, and the terminal interface has not had a full manual walkthrough. See [test coverage](https://github.com/Mistakey/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider/blob/v0.1.0/docs/verification.md) for the tested commits and remaining limits. Known upstream dependency advisories are documented in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Mistakey/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider/blob/v0.1.0/SECURITY.md).

The [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider/v/0.1.0) and attached tarball are byte-identical to the artifact checked by CI. `SHA256SUMS` contains its checksum. Source commit: `af53f2883369d5aeefef4475b8e12ac7d55e69c6`.

This first version was published with the owner's interactive npm authorization. It does not have a CI/OIDC provenance attestation.

## 简体中文

OpenCode v2 的 CLIProxyAPI provider 首个版本。

- 读取 CPA 模型列表，使用 OpenCode 原生 HTTP/SSE 或 WebSocket 连接，支持工具调用和对话摘要。
- 通过连接向导输入 API key，输入内容不明文显示，连接保存在 OpenCode 的凭证存储中。
- 切换 Fast 模式、暂停和恢复请求，查看会话耗时、TPS、token 和缓存用量。
- 一次安装即可使用服务端插件和终端界面，无需下载源码。

### 安装

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider@0.1.0
```

安装后打开 OpenCode，运行 `/cpa-connect`。配置、命令和升级方法见[中文 README](https://github.com/Mistakey/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider/blob/v0.1.0/README.zh-CN.md)。

### 测试情况

已在 **Windows / OpenCode 2.0.26** 上测试。[CI](https://github.com/Mistakey/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider/actions/runs/38350539294) 通过类型检查、**281 项测试及 38 项安装包检查**，使用本机模拟服务和测试凭证。

真实 CPA 测试仅覆盖 `gpt-6.1-sol`。native 压缩目前只通过模拟服务测试，终端界面尚未完整手动测试。具体提交和测试范围见[测试覆盖表](https://github.com/Mistakey/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider/blob/v0.1.0/docs/verification.md)；已知上游依赖告警见[安全说明](https://github.com/Mistakey/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider/blob/v0.1.0/SECURITY.md)。

[npm 上的安装包](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider/v/0.1.0)及附件均与 CI 检查过的产物完全一致，校验值在 `SHA256SUMS` 中。对应源码提交为 `af53f2883369d5aeefef4475b8e12ac7d55e69c6`。

首个版本通过包所有者的 npm 交互授权发布，不含 CI/OIDC 来源证明。
